name: financial-services-workflows
description: Institutional-style financial analysis workflows for modeling, investment banking, equity research, private equity, fund administration, operations, and advisor support. Skills-first and portable across ChatGPT, Codex, and OpenAI agent environments.

interface.longDescription: Reusable institutional-style finance skills for valuation, financial modeling, investment banking, equity research, private equity, fund administration, KYC review, and advisor-support workflows. Outputs are analyst work product for human review; the plugin does not execute trades, approve transactions, or replace licensed legal, tax, accounting, compliance, or investment professionals.
defaultPrompt: Use Financial Services to analyze this company end-to-end and automatically select the appropriate finance workflows.
Use Financial Services to analyze the latest earnings, update the model and thesis, and identify the next catalysts.
Use Financial Services to build an institutional-quality valuation with explicit scenarios, sensitivities, and validation checks.
